assets.name: frostgate
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: premium Nordic RTS map illustration. Input image 1 is the edit target, Frostgate. Refine the provided artwork into a substantially higher-quality, highly detailed stylized 3D game environment illustration. Preserve the original high oblique camera, wide landscape composition and map geography: cyan glacier ravine running through the center, snow-covered rocky terraces on both sides, the central steel bridge spanning the chasm, upper-right cluster of weathered red timber utility buildings, small modern olive utility vehicles on the roads, scattered snow-dusted conifers. Keep buildings, bridge, vehicles and paths at coherent game-world scale. Elevate precisely modeled faceted rock and ice forms, deep translucent cyan ice with fine fractures and frosted edges, crisp layered snow drifts, readable packed-snow vehicle routes, metal truss details, worn timber planks, believable roof snow, realistic water and ice floes. Use premium art-directed stylized materials, clear atmospheric depth, soft cool winter daylight with subtle warm sun edge highlights, clean ambient occlusion and controlled shadows so traversable terraces and the bridge are instantly readable. Retain Frostgate's cold pale blue, snow white and dark stone identity; no new major structures or geographic changes. Request output 2560x1440, 16:9 landscape, clean full-bleed high-resolution illustration. No text, labels, UI, border, logo or watermark. Avoid photographic noise, blur, muddy detail, excessive tiny clutter and toy-like scale.
